title: 第14章 谈成一笔大交易
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: “认识一下，我叫罗八刀，他们都叫我刀哥。”“这黑市是我罩着的。”辰楠点点头，“叫我辰楠就行。”他并没隐瞒，直接报了名字。这些人若是想要找他，花点心思就可以，因此他也没必要隐瞒。“辰楠小兄弟，以后我们就是朋友。”罗八刀笑了笑，“小哥是哪里人？”他状似随意地问道。“京城本地人。”辰楠的回答很随意，“家里在乡下有点地，今年运气好，南瓜长得特别旺。”罗八刀虽然将信将疑，但做这行最重要的就是不该问的不同，便也不再深究。“刀哥都给钱了，那我也先把货给你。”辰楠心里明白，罗八刀提前支付货款，是对实力的自信。也是一种无声的警告——既然敢提前给钱，就不怕你拿了钱跑路。“有人的话，都喊来帮忙搬。”辰楠起身，朝着屋外走去。罗八刀想了想，喊了十个得力手下跟着。十一人一前一后，沉默地穿过曲折的胡同。约莫走了一炷香的时间，辰楠带着两人来到黑市外一处荒废的草地。这里曾经是个打谷场，如今荒草丛生，几间破败的土坯房在夜色中若隐若现。“在这等着，东西应该被放在里面了。”辰楠对身边的人开口，自已则走向最大的那间土坯房。他在破房子里磨蹭了一会，借着夜色的掩护，意念一动，空间里的十个大南瓜便整整齐齐地出现在空地上。每个南瓜都硕大无比，金黄色的外皮在月光下泛着诱人的光泽。“在这里，都过来。”辰楠朝等在外面的人招手。当十个马仔看到空地上那一排巨型南瓜时，顿时傻了眼。他们也算是见过世面的，可这么大的南瓜，今天前别说见，连听都没听说过。“这南瓜是真大啊！”一个年轻些的马仔结结巴巴，伸手摸了摸最近的一个南瓜，“俺的娘哎，这一个得有一百多斤吧？”另一个年纪稍长的马仔虽然没说话，但眼中的震惊之色丝毫不减。他绕着南瓜转了两圈，忍不住问道：“小哥，这些南瓜是哪来的？怎么长得这么大？”辰楠早就准备好了说辞：“这是新品种，乡下试验田里种的，刚出现在市面上。”这个解释合情合理，半真半假，他们也没法去查，既说明了南瓜的来历，又解释了为什么市面上见不到。一群人将信将疑，但也没有多问什么，暂时没带板车，他们也只能上手扛。十人上前，一人扛起一个大南瓜就朝黑市里走去。辰楠离开黑市时，手里空空如也。走在回家的路上，辰楠的步子格外轻快。他原本只是想来摸摸情况，没想到第一笔交易就如此顺利。如今是三年困难时期，空间里那些看似普通的南瓜，在这个特殊的年代成了抢手货。空间里的南瓜长势惊人，如果强势催熟，几天就能成熟一批。如果好好利用这个优势，不仅能让家人吃饱饭，还能换来各种急需的物资。不过他也知道，种植南瓜太单调，还得找一些别的种子来种植。今天那些个巨型南瓜太过惹眼，已经引起了太多人的注意。巨型南瓜要尽快出手，等市场上的南瓜多了，或许就没人关注了。南瓜不是没有百斤重的，只是比较少，因此也不算什么稀缺货，不会有人注意到他身上来。回到家中，父母已经睡下。辰楠轻手轻脚地走进厨房，将空间里的鸡蛋和白糖取出一些，放在灶台上。想了想他还把一个南瓜取出来，这可是好东西，怎么说也得让爸妈尝尝。明天母亲起来做饭时，一定会惊喜万分。他轻手轻脚地摸回自已的小屋，插上门闩，这才从怀里掏出那叠钞票。二十张“大团结”在月光下泛着淡淡的光泽。辰楠无聊地一张一张数着，心里盘算着这些钱该如何合理地拿出来用。一万斤南瓜，按照两毛钱一斤算，就是两千块钱。在这个工人月薪只有三四十块的年代，这无疑是一笔巨款。辰楠也清楚，与罗八刀这样的人打交道，无异于与虎谋皮。今天对方客客气气，是因为看中他手中的资源。但他并没什么好担心的，他这具身体在逐渐恢复增强力量。主要是以后花钱时怕爸妈打破砂锅问到底，到时候他真不知道如何回答好。他想要购买的东西很多，今日也换到了许多东西，但这远远不够。想给家里添置粮食，给父母做新衣裳，还要买好多好东西带回乡下，让九个妹妹能吃饱饭......辰楠心情很好，意识进入空间内，用灵泉溪水浇灌了一遍南瓜。黑土地里的南瓜长势良好，一根南瓜苗多的结了十几个果。有灵泉溪水的滋养，南瓜生长速度极快，一万斤并不是什么难事。金灿灿的南瓜果实遍布黑土地，看到这些粮食心情好。俗话说得好，手里有粮心里不慌。窗外传来几声犬吠，辰楠吹熄油灯，躺在床上。窗外，月色正好。辰楠带着对明天的期待，渐渐进入了梦乡。清晨。第一缕阳光才刚刚照进四合院。辰楠就被厨房里传来的一声尖叫惊醒了。“哎呀，我的老天爷！”是母亲李秀兰的声音，带着难以置信的颤抖。辰楠迷迷糊糊地一个激灵从床上跳起来，三步并作两步冲进厨房。只见李秀兰站在灶台前，一手捂着嘴，一手指着灶台上的东西，眼睛瞪得老大。“这、这是...”李秀兰结结巴巴地说不出完整的话。辰楠定睛一看，只见灶台上摆着他昨晚从空间里取出来的十几个鸡蛋、一小袋白糖，还有约莫两三斤白面（买的）在六十年代普通工人家庭，不是过年不是过节的，很难一下子出现那么多东西。最让人不可思议的是那个巨型南瓜！难道是这个巨物吓到老妈了？“妈，怎么了这是？”“小楠，你快过来瞅瞅！”李秀兰一把拉住儿子的手，声音还在发颤，“这白糖、这鸡蛋...还有这白面！咱家什么时候有这些好东西了？”就在这时，门外传来急促的敲门声。伴随着一个熟悉的声音。
content_en: "Let me get to know each other, my name is Luo Badao, and they all call me Brother Dao." "I am responsible for this black market." Chen Nan nodded, "Just call me Chen Nan." He did not hide anything and directly reported his name.If these people want to find him, they can just put some effort into it, so there is no need for him to hide it."Brother Chen Nan, we will be friends from now on." Luo Badao smiled, "Where are you from, little brother?" he asked casually."A native of the capital." Chen Nan answered casually, "My family has some land in the countryside. I'm lucky this year and the pumpkins are growing particularly prosperously." Although Luo Badao was doubtful, the most important thing in this business was the difference that shouldn't be asked, so he didn't go into details."Brother Dao has given you the money, so I will give you the goods first." Chen Nan knew in his heart that Luo Badao paid for the goods in advance, which was a sign of confidence in his strength.It is also a silent warning - since you dare to give money in advance, I am not afraid that you will take the money and run away."If anyone is around, call over to help move." Chen Nan stood up and walked out of the house.Luo Badao thought for a while and called ten capable men to follow him.The eleven people walked through the winding alley in silence.After walking for about a stick of incense, Chen Nan led the two of them to a deserted grassland outside the black market.This place used to be a threshing floor, but now it is overgrown with grass, and several dilapidated adobe houses are looming in the night."Wait here, the things should be put inside." Chen Nan said to the people around him, and walked towards the largest adobe room.He lingered in the dilapidated house for a while, and under the cover of night, with a thought, ten large pumpkins in the space appeared neatly in the open space.Each pumpkin is huge, and its golden skin glows attractively in the moonlight."Here, come here." Chen Nan waved to the people waiting outside.When the ten horse boys saw the row of giant pumpkins in the open space, they were stunned.They have seen the world, but they have never heard of such a big pumpkin before today."This pumpkin is really big!" A younger Ma Zai stammered, reaching out to touch the nearest pumpkin, "My mother, this one must weigh more than a hundred kilograms, right?" Although the other slightly older Ma Zai did not speak, the shock in his eyes did not diminish at all.He walked around the pumpkin twice and couldn't help but ask: "Brother, where did these pumpkins come from? Why do they grow so big?" Chen Nan had already prepared an explanation: "This is a new variety, grown in experimental fields in the countryside, and just appeared on the market." This explanation was reasonable and half-true, and they couldn't check it out. It not only explained the origin of the pumpkins, but also explained why they were not seen on the market.A group of people were doubtful, but they didn't ask any questions. They didn't have a cart for the time being, so they could only carry it with their hands.Ten people stepped forward, one person picked up a big pumpkin and walked towards the black market.When Chen Nan left the black market, his hands were empty.On the way home, Chen Nan's steps were particularly brisk.He originally just wanted to get a feel for the situation, but he didn't expect that the first transaction would go so smoothly.Now is the difficult period of three years. Those seemingly ordinary pumpkins in the space have become hot commodities in this special era.The pumpkins in the space grow amazingly. If they are ripened vigorously, a batch can mature in a few days.If you make good use of this advantage, you can not only keep your family fed, but also exchange for various urgently needed supplies.But he also knew that growing pumpkins was too monotonous, and he had to find other seeds to grow.Those giant pumpkins today are too eye-catching and have attracted too many people's attention.Giant pumpkins need to be sold as soon as possible. When there are more pumpkins on the market, no one may pay attention to them.It's not that the pumpkin weighs less than a hundred pounds, it's just that it's relatively small, so it's not a scarce commodity and no one will notice it.When I got home, my parents had already gone to bed.Chen Nan walked into the kitchen quietly, took out some eggs and sugar from the space, and placed them on the stove.After thinking for a while, he took out a pumpkin. This was a good thing, and I had to let my parents try it anyway.Mom will be pleasantly surprised when she gets up to cook tomorrow.He quietly returned to his hut, bolted the door, and then took out the stack of banknotes from his arms.Twenty sheets of "Great Unity" glowed faintly in the moonlight.Chen Nan counted them one by one boredly, thinking about how to use the money reasonably.Ten thousand kilograms of pumpkin, calculated as two cents per kilogram, is two thousand yuan.In this era when workers' monthly salary is only thirty or forty yuan, this is undoubtedly a huge sum of money.Chen Nan also knew that dealing with people like Luo Badao was tantamount to seeking the skin of a tiger.The reason why the other party is so polite today is because they appreciate the resources in his hands.But he has nothing to worry about. His body is gradually recovering and gaining strength.The main reason is that when he spends money in the future, he is afraid that his parents will break the casserole and ask the truth. When the time comes, he really doesn’t know how to answer.He wanted to buy a lot of things, and he got a lot of things in exchange for them today, but it was far from enough.She wanted to buy more food for her family, make new clothes for her parents, and buy a lot of good things to take back to the countryside so that her nine sisters could have enough to eat... Chen Nan was in a good mood, and her consciousness entered the space and watered the pumpkin with the water of the spiritual spring stream.Pumpkins grow well in the black soil, and one pumpkin seedling bears more than a dozen fruits.With the nourishment of Lingquan stream, pumpkins grow very fast, and it is not difficult to grow 10,000 kilograms.Golden pumpkin fruits are spread all over the black land, and I feel good when I see these grains.As the saying goes, if you have food in your hand, you won’t panic.Several dogs barked outside the window. Chen Nan turned off the oil lamp and lay down on the bed.Outside the window, the moonlight was just right.Chen Nan gradually fell into sleep with expectations for tomorrow.early morning.The first ray of sunshine has just shined into the courtyard.Chen Nan was awakened by a scream coming from the kitchen."Oh, my God!" It was her mother Li Xiulan's voice, trembling with disbelief.Chen Nan jumped up from the bed in a daze, and rushed into the kitchen in three steps at a time.I saw Li Xiulan standing in front of the stove, covering her mouth with one hand and pointing to the things on the stove with her other hand, her eyes widened."This, this is..." Li Xiulan stuttered and couldn't finish her sentence.Chen Nan took a closer look and saw on the stove were a dozen eggs that he took out from the space last night, a small bag of sugar, and about two or three kilograms of white flour (bought). In ordinary working-class families in the 1960s, it was not a Chinese New Year or a holiday, so it was difficult for so many things to appear at once.The most incredible thing is the giant pumpkin!Could it be that this giant thing scared my mother?"Mom, what's wrong?" "Xiaonan, come here and take a look!" Li Xiulan held her son's hand, her voice still trembling, "This sugar, these eggs...and this white flour! When did our family have these good things?" At this moment, there was a rapid knock on the door.Accompanied by a familiar voice.
